verses.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
verses.sm: ONA fai ai lea e le fanauga a Isaraelu le amio leaga i luma o Ieova; ona tuuina atu ai lea o i latou e Ieova i lima o Mitiana i tausaga e fitu.

verses.en: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
verses.sm: Ua manumalo Mitiana ia Isaraelu ; ona fai ai lea e le fanauga a Isaraelu mo i latou o lua o i mauga, o ana foi, ma ‘olo, ona o Mitiana.

verses.en: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
verses.sm: A totō mea e Isaraelu ona o ae ai lea o Mitiana, ma Amaleka, atoa ma tagata mai sasae, ua latou o ae lava e tau ma i latou.

verses.en: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
verses.sm: Ua latou to lauapi e tau ma i latou, ona latou faataumaoi ai lea o mea na tutupu i le laueleele, e oo atu lava i Kasa ; latou te lei tuuna lava sina mea e ‘ai mā Isaraelu, po o se mamoe, po o se povi, po o se asini.

verses.en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
verses.sm: Auā na latou o ae ma a latou manu ma o latou fale ie, ua latou o ae lava e pei o se ina taa tele; e le mafaitaulia lava i latou ma a latou kamela; na latou oo atu foi i le nuu e faataumaoi ai.

verses.en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona matuā matitiva ai lea o Isaraelu ona o Mitiana; ona alalaga ai lea o le fanauga a Isaraelu ia Ieova.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,
verses.sm: Ua alalaga atu ia Ieova le fanauga a Isaraelu ona o Mitiana,

verses.en: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
verses.sm: ona auina ma ai lea e Ieova o le perofeta i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua faapea mai o ia ia te i latou, Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o Ieova le Atua o Isaraelu, O a‘u na ou aveina ae outou nai Aikupito, ma au aumaia outou nai le mea sa nofo pologa ai;

verses.en: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
verses.sm: na ou laveaiina outou nai le lima o Aiku pito, ai lima lava o i latou uma e na faasaua ia te outou, ma ou tulia i latou i o outou luma; na ou avatu foi lo latou laueleele mo outou.

verses.en: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
verses.sm: Na ou faapea atu foi ia te outou, O a‘u o Ieova lo outou Atua ; aua tou te matatau i atua o sa Amori, e o latou le nuu ua outou nonofo ai; a ua outou le anaana i La‘u upu.

verses.en: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
verses.sm: Ona alu atu ai lea o le agelu a Ieova, ua nofo i lalo o le tapeneto sa i Ofira, na ia Ioasa le sa Apieserū ; o Kitiona lona atalii ua ia sasa saito i le mea e soli ai vine, ina ia lilo ai ia Mitiana.

verses.en: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
verses.sm: Ua faaali mai ia te ia le agelu a Ieova, ua faapea mai ia te ia, Oe na le toa malosi, o ia te oe Ieova.

verses.en: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Kitiona ia te ia, E ! le Alii e, afai ua ia te i matou Ieova, se a le mea ua oo mai ai ia mea uma ia te i matou; o ifea ona vavega uma, na ta‘u mai ai e o matou tamā ia te i matou, ua faapea mai, E lei aveina ae ea o i tatou e Ieova ai Aikupito ? A o ona po nei ua lafoaiina ai i matou e Ieova, ua ia tuuina mai foi i matou i lima o Mitiana.

verses.en: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
verses.sm: Ona silasila mai ai lea o Ieova ia te ia, ua faapea mai, Alu ia oe i lenei lou malosi, e te laveaiina Isaraelu ai le lima o Mitiana ; ou te lei auina atu ea oe ?

verses.en: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu ai lea o ia ia te ia, E ! le Alii e, ou te laveaiina Isaraelu i ni a? faauta mai, ua topito ona faatauvaa lo‘u aiga i Manase; o a‘u foi, o le aupito itiiti i le aiga o lo‘u tarna.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai ai lea o Ieova ia te ia, Auā ta te faatasi lava ma oe; e te fasia foi Mitiana, e peiseai o se tagata e toatasi.

verses.en: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia ia te ia, Afai ua e alofa mai ia te au, ia e faia se faailoga mo a‘u, e iloa ai o oe lava ua ta tautalatala ma a‘u.

verses.en: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
verses.sm: Ou te faatoga atu, aua ne‘i e maliu ese iinei, seia a‘u sau ia te oe, ma ou au mai la‘u taulaga, ma ou tuuina atu i ou luma. Ona faapea mai ai lea o ia, Ou te nofo lava seia e foi mai.

verses.en: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
verses.sm: Ua alu atu Kitiona, ua ia saunia le tamai ‘oti, ma areto e le faafefeteina na faia i le efa o falaoa ; ua tuu e ia tufaaga i le ato, ua ia tuu foi le sua i le pani, ona avatu lea ia te ia i lalo o le tapeneto, ma tuu atu ai.

verses.en: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le agelu a le Atua ia te ia, Ina tago ia i tufaaga, ma areto e le faafefeteina, ma e tuu atu i luga o lenei papa, ia liligi atu ai foi le sua. Ona faapea ai lea o ia ona fai.

verses.en: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
verses.sm: Ona faaloaloa atu lea e le agelu a Ieova le pito tootoo na i lona lima, ua pai atu i tufaaga ma areto e le faafefeteina ; ona alu ae ai lea o le afi nai le papa, ua susunuina ai tufaaga ma areto e le faafefeteina, Ona alu ai lea o le agelu a Ieova nai ia te ia.

verses.en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord GOD! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e Kitiona o le agelu a Ieova lava o ia, ona faapea ane ai lea o Kitiona, Aue, le Alii e, ieova, auā ua ou iloa le agelu a Ieova, ua rna fesagai lava.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai iea o ieova ia te ia, Ina filemu ia oe, aua o te mata‘u, e te le oti.

verses.en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
verses.sm: Ona faia ai lea e Kitiona i lea mea o le fata faitaulaga ia Ieova, ua faaigoa i ai o leova-saloma; ua i ai i Ofira o sa Apieserū ua oo i ona po nei.

verses.en: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai Ieova ia fe ia i lea lava po, Ina ave ia le povi poa taanoa a lou tamā, ma lona lua o povi poa, e fitu ona tausaga, ma ia e soloi i lalo le fata faitaulaga o Paala, o i lou tamā; ia vavae foi i lalo le tupua o Asaira ua latalata ane i ai;

verses.en: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
verses.sm: a ia e faia se fata e fai ai taulaga ia Ieova lou Atua i luga o lenei ‘olo, ma le fafie ua faaafu; e te ave foi lona lua o povi poa, e te fai ai se taulaga mu i le laau o le tupua o Asaria o le a e vavae i lalo.

verses.en: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e Kitiona o tagata e toasefulu o ana auauna, ua faia lava e pei ona fetalai mai ai o Ieova ia te ia ; ua faia e ia i le po, auā e le mafai ia te ia ona faia i le ao, ina ua mata‘u lava o ia i le aiga o lona tamā atoa ma tāgata o le aai.

verses.en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
verses.sm: Ua ala i le taeao tagata o le aai, faauta ua soloia i lalo le falafaitaulaga o Paala, ma le tupua o Asaira na latalata ane i ai ua vavaeina i lalo ; ua fai foi le taulaga i le lua o povi poa i luga o le fata ua faia.

verses.en: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
verses.sm: Ona latou faapea ane ai lea o le tasi i le tasi, Po o ai ea ua faia le mea nei ? Ua fesilisili ma suesue i latou, ona fai ane ai lea o i latou, Na faia le mea nei e Kitiona le atālii o Ioasa.

verses.en: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu ai lea o tagata o le aai ia Ioas.a, Au mai ia lou atalii, ina ia oti o ia ; auā ua ia soloia le fata faitaulaga o Paala, auā foi ua ia vavaeina i lalo le tupua o Asaira na latalata ane i ai.

verses.en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.
verses.sm: Ona faapea mai ai lea o Ioasa ia te i latou uma na tutū mai ia te ia, O outou na, tou te finafinau ea ! mo Paala ? Tou te fia laveaiina o ia ? o le na te finau mo ia, ia oti lava ia i le taeao nei; afai o se atua ia, ina faia e ia lava lana finauga, auā ua s51oia e se tasi lona fata faitaulaga;

verses.en: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
verses.sm: o lea lava aso na ia faaigoaina ai o ia, o Ierupaala, ua faapea atu, Ia la finau o Paala ma ia, auā ua ia soloia lona fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopoto faatasi ai lea o Mitiana uma lava, ma Amaleka atoa ma tagata mai sasae, ua latou sopoia mai le 'vaitafe, ua latou to lauapi i le vanu o Isereelu.

verses.en: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.
verses.sm: A ua ufitia Kitiona e le Agaga o Ieeva; ona ili ai lea e ia o le pu, ona faapotopotoina lea o Apieseru e mulimuli atu ia te ia.

verses.en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
verses.sm: Ua ia aauina atu sāvali ia Manase uma, ua faapotopotoina foi i latou e mulimuli atu ia te ia; ua ia aauina atu o sāvali ia Asera, ma Sepulona, ma Nafatali, ona latou o ae ai lea e faafetaiai ia te i latou.

verses.en: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
verses.sm: Ua faapea atu Kitiona i le Atua, Afai e te faaolaina Isaraelu i lo‘u lima, e pei ona e fetalai mai ai,

verses.en: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
verses.sm: faauta mai, o a‘u, ou te tuuina atu le fuLufulu mamoe i le mea e sasa ai le saito ; afai ua na o le fulufulu mamoe e i ai le sau, a e matutu le laueleele uma, ona ou iloa ai lea e te faaolaina Isaraelu i lo‘u nei lima, e pei ona e fetalai mai ai.

verses.en: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
verses.sm: Ona faapea ai lava lea; ua ala usu atu ia i le taeao, ona tatao ai lea e ia o le fulufulu mamoe, ua ia tāulia foi le sau nai le fulufulu mamoe, ua tumu le ipu i le suāvai.

verses.en: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu iea o Kitiona i le Atua, Aua e te toatamai ia te au, ua na o le toe upu ou te fai atu ai nei; ou te aioi atu ia te oe, ia toe tasi ona ou tofotofo i le fulufulu mamoe ; ia matutu na o le fulufulu mamoe, a o le laueleele uma, ia i ai le sau.

verses.en: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
verses.sm: Ua faapea lava ona faia e le Atua i lea lava po ; auā ua matutu na o le fulufulu mamoe, a o le laueleele uma, sa i ai le sau. Ua faatoaitiitiina cau a Kifiona.
